description.en: A conducting rod moving on a U-shaped rail in a uniform magnetic field directed into the plane of the paper.
description.hi: कागज के तल के लंबवत अंदर की ओर निर्देशित एकसमान चुंबकीय क्षेत्र में U-आकार की रेल पर गतिमान एक चालक छड़।

svgContent:
<svg viewBox="0 0 400 300" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg">
  <!-- Magnetic Field (Crosses indicating into the page) -->
  <g stroke="#9ca3af" stroke-width="2">
    <!-- Row 1 -->
    <path d="M50,40 L70,60 M70,40 L50,60" />
    <path d="M130,40 L150,60 M150,40 L130,60" />
    <path d="M210,40 L230,60 M230,40 L210,60" />
    <path d="M290,40 L310,60 M310,40 L290,60" />
    <!-- Row 2 -->
    <path d="M50,110 L70,130 M70,110 L50,130" />
    <path d="M130,110 L150,130 M150,110 L130,130" />
    <path d="M210,110 L230,130 M230,110 L210,130" />
    <path d="M290,110 L310,130 M310,110 L290,130" />
    <!-- Row 3 -->
    <path d="M50,180 L70,200 M70,180 L50,200" />
    <path d="M130,180 L150,200 M150,180 L130,200" />
    <path d="M210,180 L230,200 M230,180 L210,200" />
    <path d="M290,180 L310,200 M310,180 L290,200" />
    <!-- Row 4 -->
    <path d="M50,250 L70,270 M70,250 L50,270" />
    <path d="M130,250 L150,270 M150,250 L130,270" />
    <path d="M210,250 L230,270 M230,250 L210,270" />
    <path d="M290,250 L310,270 M310,250 L290,270" />
  </g>

  <!-- U-shaped Rail -->
  <path d="M350,80 L80,80 L80,230 L350,230" fill="none" stroke="#4b5563" stroke-width="6" />

  <!-- Conducting Rod -->
  <line x1="220" y1="60" x2="220" y2="250" stroke="#f59e0b" stroke-width="12" stroke-linecap="round" />

  <!-- Velocity Vector -->
  <line x1="230" y1="155" x2="280" y2="155" stroke="#ef4444" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="280,155 272,148 272,162" fill="#ef4444" />

  <!-- Dimension lines -->
  <!-- Length of rod -->
  <line x1="60" y1="80" x2="60" y2="230" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="55" y1="80" x2="65" y2="80" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  <line x1="55" y1="230" x2="65" y2="230" stroke="#3b82f6" stroke-width="2" />
  
  <!-- Distance x -->
  <line x1="80" y1="245" x2="220" y2="245" stroke="#10b981" stroke-width="2" stroke-dasharray="4" />

  <!-- Induced current direction (clockwise here, since flux out is decreasing/flux in is increasing) -->
  <!-- Actually, flux into page is increasing, so induced field is out of page. By RHR, current is counter-clockwise. -->
  <path d="M150,70 Q130,70 120,90" fill="none" stroke="#8b5cf6" stroke-width="3" />
  <polygon points="120,90 115,80 127,82" fill="#8b5cf6" />

</svg>
